name: File Inclusion / Sensitive File Exposure
attack_scenario: a user-controlled value selects which file to include or serve, so an attacker reads sensitive files (.env, keys, /etc/passwd) or includes attacker-controlled code
negative_test_hint: request the file/module as '../../.env' (or a remote URL for PHP) and assert access is refused

exemplar.explanation: map user input through a fixed allowlist to a known file; never build an include/serve path from raw input
